A realistic colored gym instruction illustration matching reference images: muscular adult man with the SAME identity, warm tan skin, dark short hair, black/dark charcoal shorts, black trainers with white sole. Treat this as nine successive exposures of ONE locked-off animation scene, not nine independent redesigns. Skin texture, machine parts, clothing, dumbbells, lighting and all fixed objects must remain identical between cells. Reference 1 supplies exercise/equipment identification; Reference 2 supplies the approved muscular character rendering style. Do not include the pec-deck machine from reference 2. EXERCISE: dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift / stiff com halteres. The man holds exactly TWO identical dark hex dumbbells in straight relaxed arms in front of his thighs, neutral wrists and closed grips. Heels, toes and both complete soles stay planted. Cell1 tall hips, cell9 hips back and still high, chest lower, thighs near vertical with slight knee bend; preserve the hamstring-hinge pattern. Do not round the lumbar spine, do not overarch, do not bend knees deeply, do not lift heels, do not reach floor or hyperextend at upright. One unchanging anatomy and dumbbell geometry in all nine cells.
